page.overview:
Who is Alekam?

Alekam was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi combat instructor during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. A dark-skinned Human, Alekam was stationed on the planet Ilum, and wore brown and gold armor under brown robes.
